description:
Documentation audit (2026-04-01) found that the two foundational design docs
are severely outdated:

1. `docs/design/architecture.md` describes a non-existent `.run()` method
   and Template Method pattern. The actual execution model is lifecycle-based
   via `ExecutionPhases` and `BenchmarkResults` models. Missing entirely:
   `DataFrameContext`, `ExpressionFamilyAdapter`, `PandasFamilyAdapter`
   classes and the whole DataFrame execution path.

2. `docs/design/structure.md` completely omits `benchbox/core/` (30+
   subsystems) and `benchbox/platforms/` (40+ database adapters). A user
   reading this doc cannot understand the actual project organization.

These are the docs developers read FIRST when trying to understand the
codebase. Getting them wrong cascades into confusion everywhere.

verifications.command: grep -n 'Template Method\|\.run()' docs/design/architecture.md || echo 'PASS: no stale pattern refs'
verifications.description: No references to non-existent .run() Template Method pattern

verifications.command: for d in core platforms benchmarks cli; do grep -q "benchbox/$d" docs/design/structure.md && echo "PASS: $d" || echo "FAIL: $d missing"; done
grep -c 'ExpressionFamilyAdapter\|PandasFamilyAdapter' docs/design/architecture.md | xargs -I{} test {} -ge 2 && echo 'PASS: adapter families documented' || echo 'FAIL: adapter families missing'
verifications.description: DataFrame adapter families documented in architecture.md

work_units.summary: Map current execution model, key classes, and data flow
Rewrite architecture.md with current execution model
Rewrite structure.md with complete directory map
